beforePause.dialog:
EYES ONLY // VESPER
×
BRING THEM HOME.

The Drowned Relay was built to preserve human memories. Last night, it began broadcasting them as a distress call.

BREACH THE STATION

Use the central yard and its side lanes. Concrete cover breaks a sentinel's line of sight.

RECOVER THREE CORES

Follow the cyan signal pylons to the waist-high memory receivers five metres in front. Approach a receiver and hold E for one second. Stay nearby while the memory is recovered. Each recovery escalates the defense response.

RETURN TO EXTRACTION

Bring all three memories to the green beacon where you entered. Follow either lit return aisle around the induction block. At the beacon, face back toward the yard and move between the split blast baffles while the uplink completes. Watch the open flanks.

Red means danger. Cyan means life. Soul Shift is your way through.

ACCEPT BRIEFING
↗

Soul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.

THREAT VISOR · Orange brackets beside an optic mean charging; muted brackets mean recent fire or hit. One lower readout identifies the eligible target nearest your aim, with a small retarget margin. Bearing chevrons combine all enemy types in a 30-degree sector: CHARGES counts charging enemies, SOURCES counts every eligible enemy there, including recent fire/hits. Charge warnings take priority over those histories. Type and individual histories are omitted only in bearing groups. Cues require clear optic line of sight, expire, and never show all enemies. The memory archive retains recovered stories when combat compacts their card.

UNDERSTOOD
↗

RESTORED RECORDS
×
THE VOICES WE CARRY.
MARA SOLBERG
STATION MEDIC

“If someone finds this… the children made the last ferry. Tell them I kept the light on.”

ELIAN VALE
RELAY ENGINEER

“I could erase the station. I could not erase the people inside it. Bring them home.”

SERA NORD
NIGHT OPERATOR

“Every signal is a person. If you can hear me, we are still here.”
